title: Pass in label for primary index

comments.body:
In this case you are using a custom autocomplete instantiation, this means that  you  can also add new widget parameters. The parameters which you currently  are passing are `container`  &  `indices`. If you add a new parameter like `mainLabel` there, you will be able to read that as `renderOptions.widgetParams.mainLabel` inside your custom render function. 

In case this isn't clear enough, it would be useful if you gave an example on [codesandbox](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js) with your custom widget included.

I'll close this issue for now, but don't hesitate to respond if this was unclear still
